You are shorter right now than when you woke up 📏

The discs between your vertebrae have soft, watery centres. Gravity squeezes them flatter during the day, and they plump back up while you lie down at night. In one study people lost about 1.4 cm over the day and got it back overnight. In space, astronauts can grow up to 3% taller until Earth takes it back.

Want to be measured at your tallest? Do it before breakfast.

Sources: British Journal of Sports Medicine, Archives of Disease in Childhood, StatPearls, Scientific American.
